description: The critical infrastructure page of the Slovak Ministry of Interior publishes the public part of the national list of critical entities, kept under section 5(d) of Act 367/2024 on critical infrastructure, which transposed the EU Critical Entities Resilience Directive (2022/2557) from 1 January 2025. The list is a table by sector, subsector and essential service, giving the business name, company number and registered address of each critical entity, for eleven sectors: energy, transport, finance, postal services, health, water and atmosphere, digital infrastructure, public administration, space, food production and distribution, and industry. For example, it names the electricity supplier, the transmission system operator SEPS, the three distribution companies and the market operator OKTE under electricity. The page also explains the CER, NIS2 and DORA context and states that critical infrastructure documentation itself is classified. Access is free on the web page; no licence is stated. Caveats: only entities and services are listed, without asset locations, and the page is in Slovak. Coverage is Slovakia. It supports interdependency and cascading failure studies that need to know which operators provide essential services; related records are the CISI critical infrastructure spatial index, MIRACA pan-European critical infrastructure exposure and the Croatia disaster risk assessment.
